scope: Read-only source and existing receipt audit. No training, prediction or truth payloads were evaluated.
current_pairing_verdict_limit: Source and receipt review is not certification of future runtime outputs. Verify actual sealed predictions and completed scoring.

comparisons.data: Fresh 30 Mb American-admixture simulations, same reference/query genomes and frozen 10,000-record support within each simulation
comparisons.supported_scope: Paired pipeline comparison on a disclosed biological reconstruction
paper_protocol_gaps: Original sample ploidy and some inference conventions unresolved
Released ARGformer contrastive temperature 0.30 and uniform weights differ from paper 0.05 and inverse-frequency description
Exact published PCA clustering and ancestry evaluator not recovered
Native top1 and FLARE marker-to-focal projection are disclosed choices

comparisons.data: Three 200 Mb training and five independent testing sequences using the 476-person roster, six-path ancestry
comparisons.supported_scope: Paired native-six comparison on common records with disclosed sampling reconstruction
paper_protocol_gaps: Released Dense network differs from paper CNN description
Exact original site and example selection not recovered

comparisons.data: AncestralPaths 476-person 200 Mb panel, BAA retained, uniform map, no genotype error, separate C4 support excluding native edge trees
comparisons.supported_scope: Available-release ARGMix transfer to shared AP scenario. Not a directly interchangeable native-six leaderboard.
paper_protocol_gaps: Not ARGMix 1,611-person BAA-excluded chr22 scenario with genotype error 0.001
Current release 15 references and no ancestor features differs from paper 25 references and three ancestors
Paper-era implementation, roster, map, error and perturbation details remain unresolved

comparisons.data: No candidate-versus-native full original-task comparison in the active queue
comparisons.supported_scope: Earlier 1,000-training-reaction native GST validation pilot and separate genealogy controls only
paper_protocol_gaps: GST absent from all 350 active tasks
Full-data candidate/native paired test comparison unfinished

conclusions: Completing the active queue does not complete the original all-paper benchmark goal
Fresh independent seeds are acceptable. Material panel, algorithm and endpoint differences are the unresolved issue
No claim of superiority over all published methods or exact reproduction of published tables is supported
